correctness.rationale: Grounded incidence formula Q=B^T(BB^T)^(-1)B, C=I-Q and exact determinant/adjugate column sums are proved for every connected graph. The standalone C99 program exhaustively covers all 27,475 labelled connected graphs with 2..6 vertices and 189,587 legal single-edge insertions, using exact integer cross-multiplication; zero decreases occur. The seven-vertex witness is exactly C=313/153 before and C=55/27 after, a strict decrease of 4/459. A second symbolic check covers all 142 unlabelled connected classes up to six vertices. Symmetry implies equal l1 and linfty norms. Enumeration is exhaustive for the finite claim, not extrapolated.

value.rationale: A canonical flow-projection endpoint norm is a natural finite-dimensional Banach operator invariant. Edge addition monotonically lowers effective resistance but need not monotonically change this norm: the exact vertex-order threshold separates all graphs through six vertices from a seven-vertex failure. The sharp universal finite cutoff is structurally meaningful irrespective of the small 4/459 numerical size. It is not a textbook substitution or a previously tabulated constant.
